name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including content, client/project association, portal visibility and private communication drafts. Entry from the Documents list carries the complete folder/filter/search/archive/view/page context into a validated `from` address; every editor exit returns there with a contextual label and restores the originating row/card, while native browser Back restores the same URL state. Direct or untrusted origins safely fall back to the Documents root. The header and sidebar show concurrent state episodes with their open duration; state history and normalized observations are covered by admin-document-state-workflow. Failed or rejected saves retain the notes draft, while issued collection accounts stay read-only and outside the generic state workflow. The Markdown clipboard toolbar, template-style preview and dual PDF download remain available.
